thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT: paging-adapter reports high delivery latency (>60s) for external SMS gateway, automated pages queued. Affected routes: critical-alerts, infra-pager. Investigating now.

alex: saw it, I'm pulling logs from the adapter. paging queue depth spike around 14:02 UTC.

robin-oncall: i'm in. do we know if any customers missed pages? @alex can you check last-ack timestamps?

alex: checking. sample query: `SELECT * FROM pager_events WHERE route='critical-alerts' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;` a bunch show status=queued, last_send_attempt=null. One partner (acme-inc) got duplicates earlier.

sre-maria: jumps in — looks like outbound gateway started timing out, adapter retries are backing up. Not a DNS issue; handshake round trips failing.

eng-lee: on it. quick workaround: disable adapter's automatic exponential retry to avoid queue pileup, then failover to backup-gateway. Will patch config in k8s.

alex: config change ready, applying: 
```
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/paging-adapter RETRY_POLICY=none
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/paging-adapter
```

pager-integration-bot: automation: routing-rule 'auto-escalate-on-unacked' suppressed due to queue error. Manual escalation required.

robin-oncall: doing manual pages now to oncall rota (primary -> secondary) while you flip gateway. Posting status to customers@status.redwood.ai after we confirm.

sre-maria: gateway switched to backup-gateway-2, adapter pods restarted, backlog draining. Latency back to ~150ms for outgoing requests.

alex: confirmation: last_send_attempt now shows timestamps and `delivered` for most queued items. small number of duplicates for acme-inc — will follow up with support.

eng-lee: opened PR to add healthcheck eviction to prevent long-queued items: https://github.com/redwood-inference/paging-adapter/pull/745 (WIP).

robin-oncall: customer impact: intermittent delayed pages for ~3% of critical-alerts between 14:01-14:06 UTC. No large-scale missing pages after failover. I posted a short status update to status page and flagged support to contact impacted customers.

sre-maria: root-cause hypothesis: outbound gateway started returning TCP RSTs while adapter was concurrently retrying -> connection churn + internal retry backoff created herd. We'll run post-incident capture and add circuit breaker.

alex: follow-up actions: 1) revert aggressive retry change to safe defaults after draining 2) add circuit-breaker and health eviction (eng-lee) 3) run end-to-end paging smoke test on canary before re-enabling auto-escalations (sre-maria) 4) support to contact acme-inc for duplicate page cleanup (robin-oncall). I'll file an incident ticket and attach logs.

robin-oncall: thanks. marking incident as MITIGATED. keeping channel open for postmortem notes and timeline. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident MITIGATED at 14:09 UTC. Incident ticket: INC-2026-3891 (created).
